How to read this board (v3): the top sections come from the SOLD RATIO tab — its status and its pending note (under Obstacles) govern for those clients; below are the /script records that are not on the tab. Conflicts between sources are flagged in red on the row, never resolved silently. Direct editing: tap the ★ to rate, change the status with the dropdown (the row moves sections), click Obstacles to write your note, adjust the FU Date — and set a time next to it to make it an FU ST (the timed date also creates the Pipeline FU task) — and log each contact with LVM / TEXT / CALL — and when a lead doesn't answer, stamp the chase with the NA text / email / lvm toggles under those buttons (the date shows next to it; tap again to clear — marks only, the board never sends anything) — everything saves to the cloud instantly and no sync wipes your edits. Click a lead's Total to change its price: type a new total, or type a discount like 10% to take that percent off the current total — the new price saves to the board and pushes straight into that client's /script record (Pipeline follows within ~10 minutes). The Payoff column shows the balance on file and 47% the standard mortgage price off it (deed-backs never price off a % — they show —). The 💲 CAT 1–9 button next to the price chips opens the category legend. Each lead's Date cell carries a cohort badge — NEW (green: this appointment is the lead's first on file), RS · from … (amber: an earlier appointment exists, dated), DB (orange: deed-back). The 🌙 NIGHT AUDIT button tallies today the LAP way — CB = today's NEW + RS leads, deed-backs excluded, outcomes of that set only — with a copy button for the nightly post. The 💳 48-MO PLAN button lists follow-ups whose notes show a UCFS denial or bad credit, each with a ready-to-send in-house proposal (30% down split over 6 monthly payments, then 48 monthly payments, straight split, no interest), plus a best-guess stall reason for every follow-up. After you change a price, the change is logged under the Total (↓ % of payoff on a mortgage, ↓ pad on a deed-back — never the $ amount discounted) with 📱 TEXTED / ✉️ EMAILED marks and a 🕘 history — bookkeeping only, the board never sends anything. The FU Date sits next to the phones: if it says ✓ TASK, that date came from your FU task in Pipeline (it beats any event); if it says event, it came from a calendar event. Search criteria (top): tap chips to combine — once = YES, twice = NO, third tap = off: YES TODAY + YES DEED-BACK shows today's deed-backs; TODAY also pulls in every lead whose Pipeline task is due today or overdue (per CRM). The two date boxes filter by ANY date on the lead — appointment, FU date, close date or task due date. Each lead's next Pipeline task shows under its FU date; its ✓ MARK COMPLETE button marks it done here and queues it to be completed in Pipeline; YES SOLD + NO DEED-BACK shows mortgage solds only. The 💲 PRICE chips sort leads by Total into 9 categories (CAT 1–5: $3,500–$10,000, CAT 6–9: $10,000–$21,000) and combine with the other chips; each lead shows its CAT under its Total, the search box finds cat 3, and each section's sort menu can order rows by Category 1–9. The search box also filters every section by name, resort, phone or status. Every date is captioned lead by lead: CLOSE DATE on sold leads (plus CHARGE DATE and PAID DATE on charged deals), FU DATE on follow-ups, RESCHEDULED TO on reschedules. Hide and sort: each section has its own button to hide or show it and its own menu to sort the rows — by name, appointment date, FU date, sale date, pay day, deal size (total), commission, stars, payoff, category or status; dates run soonest-first, money and stars biggest-first, and rows missing that key sink to the bottom — your choice saves in this browser and survives syncs. You can also click any column header in a section to sort that section by that column — click the same header again to reverse it; the arrow on the header shows the active column sort, and rows with no value for that column sink to the bottom either way. Per-lead dropdown: under each lead's status there is a small dropdown that states its facts at a glance — on sold deals whether it is CHARGED, whether the commission is PAID (with the date) or PENDING, and the pay day; on follow-ups the FU date (and the set time on an FU ST) and the appointment on file; on no-answers the appointment that no-answered. It only ever shows what the board's data records — anything unrecorded shows —. The line code: under each lead's dropdown, chips read in order — DB (deed-back) or MTG (mortgage), always · AD appointment date · CD close date · DC ID docs collected · CH payment processed/charged · FC funds collected — the date + amount of the collection that satisfies (or will satisfy, marked with a →) the deal's commission threshold, shown on deals whose commission is still unpaid · PD pay day · CP commission paid (with its date) · TC the deal's total commission — dates in M/D form. A chip appears only when the board's data proves it — DC is not shown yet, because no per-deal ID record feeds this board. The ⏳ CLOSED BUT NOT YET CHARGED ENOUGH section lists deals that closed in their correct pay period but have not yet been charged enough to earn the commission — under the threshold of 25% of the price collected or 3 consecutive payments; every row there carries its FC and the PD that follows from it, and a deal leaves the section the moment it crosses that threshold. The 💵 PAYDAY button shows ONE pay day's deals: pick the day in the dropdown and the banner states it in tense — WHAT WAS PAID (past days, CP dates on the rows), WHAT IS BEING PAID THIS FRIDAY, or WHAT IS TO BE PAID (future days) — with the deal count and the day's WT. CHARGED in two sections: if the commission payday has arrived (today or earlier), the row lands in COMMISSION PAID; if the payday is in the future or there is no payday, it stays in COMMISSION UNPAID — and it moves to paid on its own when the payday arrives. To force a row into the paid section without waiting for the payday, set its status to CHARGED-PAID in the row's status dropdown. Mortgage commission: CC/ACH 10% · UCFS 8% · UGA 4% on (total − fees − $299; fees = 3% on CC, $199 on the rest; UGA only deducts the $199). Deed-back commission: $300 + ½ of the pad; pad = total − list price − $299 − MF cycles − card fee if applicable. A Pad of — means no pad has been quoted yet (the Total is just the minimum: list + $299 + cycles). Deed-backs live separately in their 🏠 DEED-BACK sections (they do not count against the closing ratio); if the list price is not on file, the row shows "—" under List Price and keeps its recorded commission, and payroll-verified commissions (P8C) beat the formula. If there is no confirmed payment type or total, the commission shows "—" and the reason goes under Obstacles.
